BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY14-FY23 ex-FY15 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-7.7%/yr (FY25 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 9.1-yr ex-FY15 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 ex-FY24 median

BULL.desc: EPS +13.9%/yr (FY14-FY23 ex-FY15 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +48.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY14-FY23 ex-FY15 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2025-02-07) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.02x (-2.0% downside to Bear $58 / +93.5% upside to Bull $110) | Adj composite 2.75 vs market 2.01: gap +0.74 [UNDERVALUED] | -2% above the EPP floor $58 (15x FY25E $3.86) | Conservative 2-yr case: +30.9% total (+15.5%/yr) | At 14.7x FY25E the 15% hurdle price $75 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; U.S. revenues +8.6% in Q4 2024, forward revenues -5.8% (FY25 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
